name: kapelle
description: Human-controlled SDLC harness with one adaptive workflow, fast planning for small features, project architecture guidance, explicit approvals, and recoverable state.

interface.longDescription: A human-controlled SDLC harness with one adaptive workflow, progressive business and technical specifications, an XS/S fast lane, explicit approvals, scoped architecture guidance, deterministic planning, recoverable state, and separate functional, implementation, unit-test, and verification phases.
defaultPrompt: Start a new feature from my raw task with Kapelle.
Plan a small feature through Kapelle's fast lane.
Expand and review a feature business specification with Kapelle.
Plan and implement a feature with human checkpoints.
Show or recover a feature status with Kapelle.
Amend an in-progress feature safely with Kapelle.
Migrate an older Kapelle feature to the current workflow.
